title: Two neighbors
text: Two power companies share a river, but plan their work without seeing each other. The Savannah River is the border: Georgia Power builds on the Georgia side, Dominion Energy on the South Carolina side.

title: Their plans
text: Dominion plans 54 jobs. Georgia Power plans 60. Nobody lines them up. MrGridy put every one of them on one map, from their public filings.

title: Where they collide
text: Of 2,580 possible pairs, only 50 are within a crew's morning drive, forty kilometers. Two of them touch outright.

title: The best match
text: These two jobs touch. One crew, one yard, one permit instead of two. Dominion's Okatie to McIntosh 115 kilovolt Tie, and Georgia Power's Plant McIntosh expansion. Both are under construction at the same time for about 7 months.

title: What it saves
text: What working together could save: roughly $2.1 million across all 50 matches, somewhere between $1 million and $3.1 million. It is an estimate. Georgia Power does not publish its project costs, so real savings could be higher.

title: When a storm comes
text: About 55 hours before Hurricane Helene arrived, MrGridy predicted where lines would break for both companies, and compared it with what happened. It simulated the storm 10,000 times, with physics.

title: Fix it together
text: Working together, power comes back about 10 hours sooner, and 2.5 hours sooner for people who rely on powered medical equipment. Shared staging yards and crews go to the nearest repair zone first, whichever company owns it. Two neighbors, one plan.

title: Corridor fly-through
text: This is the number one match, near Rincon, Georgia. In teal, DESC's Okatie to McIntosh 115 kilovolt Tie. In orange, Georgia Power's Plant McIntosh expansion. Here the two projects touch, so their outages have to be planned together. They could share outage coordination, right-of-way, access roads and permits. One staging yard, right beside both jobs, would serve both crews. And for about 7 months, both crews are due to be here at the same time.

title: Storm crew briefing: Helene
text: Storm crew briefing for Hurricane Helene. On the Georgia side, the heaviest outages are expected in Lowndes County, Richmond County and Fulton County, with about 827,000 customers out across Georgia at the peak. On the South Carolina side, watch Greenville County, Richland County and Spartanburg County, with about 384,000 customers out statewide. The simulation expects roughly 1,100 damaged transmission sections on Georgia Power's system and 140 on DESC's. Both utilities stage jointly at I 520 bridge over the Savannah River, which reaches one repair zone within 38 minutes and I 95 bridge over the Savannah River, which reaches four repair zones within 59 minutes. Vulnerable areas first. Start near Richmond County, where about 5,000 residents rely on powered medical equipment, then Effingham County and Coffee County. Working together, power comes back about 10 hours sooner. Zone order is live on the MrGridy map. Stay safe.

title: Storm crew briefing: Helene (español)
text: Informe para las cuadrillas sobre la tormenta del huracán Helene. Del lado de Georgia, se esperan los mayores apagones en el condado de Lowndes, el condado de Richmond y el condado de Fulton, con unos 827,000 clientes sin servicio en todo Georgia en el punto máximo. Del lado de Carolina del Sur, tengan cuidado en el condado de Greenville, el condado de Richland y el condado de Spartanburg, con unos 384,000 clientes sin servicio en todo el estado. La simulación espera más o menos 1,100 secciones de transmisión dañadas en el sistema de Georgia Power y 140 en el de DESC. Ambas empresas de servicios públicos se apostarán juntas en el puente de la I-520 sobre el río Savannah, que llega a una zona de reparación en 38 minutos, y en el puente de la I-95 sobre el río Savannah, que llega a cuatro zonas de reparación en 59 minutos. Las áreas vulnerables van primero. Comiencen cerca del condado de Richmond, donde unos 5,000 residentes dependen de equipos médicos conectados a la electricidad, luego sigan en el condado de Effingham y el condado de Coffee. Trabajando juntos, la electricidad regresa unas 10 horas antes. El orden de las zonas está en vivo en el mapa de MrGridy. Cuídense.
